description: Subcommittee plans public art discussions and mentorship for artists.
Initial budget of $6,000 for workshops and artist fees.
Aims to increase awareness and support emerging artists.

chips.text: Committee debated including blank evaluation forms in minutes for transparency.
Emerging artists will receive mentorship and support for public art projects.
Is there a universal evaluation matrix for public art projects?
Detailed plan for public art events will be developed before summer.
